title: Giving Opinions and Arguing
ringkas: Ungkapan pendapat, setuju, dan tidak setuju
goals: menanyakan pendapat: [[What do you think about ...?]], [[How do you feel about ...?]]
menyatakan pendapat: [[I think ...]], [[In my opinion, ...]], [[I believe ...]]
menyatakan **setuju**, **tidak setuju**, dan **setuju sebagian** dengan sopan
memberi alasan dengan [[because]], [[since]], [[for example]], dan [[that's why]]
memakai kata penghubung kontras: [[but]], [[however]], [[although]], [[on the other hand]]
berdebat secara santun dan menulis paragraf pendapat singkat

lesson.text: Di kelas, di media sosial, dan dalam ujian lisan, kita sering diminta berpendapat. Pendapat yang baik **jelas**, **disertai alasan**, dan **sopan** terhadap pendapat orang lain. Di unit ini kamu belajar ungkapan-ungkapan untuk itu.

lesson.title: 1. Menanyakan dan menyatakan pendapat
table: [[What do you think about online classes?]]
[[In my opinion, school uniforms are important.]]
[[I believe reading is a good habit.]]
[[As far as I'm concerned, it is too expensive.]]

lesson.title: 2. Setuju dan tidak setuju
table: [[I agree with you.]] / [[That's true.]] / [[I think so too.]]
[[You have a point, but ...]] / [[I partly agree, but ...]]
[[I'm afraid I disagree.]] / [[I see your point, but I don't think so.]]
[[I totally disagree.]] / [[I don't agree at all.]]

lesson.title: Sopan saat tidak setuju
lesson.text: Jangan langsung berkata [[No, you're wrong.]] Lebih santun: [[I see your point, but ...]] atau [[I'm afraid I disagree because ...]]. Selalu sertai **alasan**.

items.ex: In my opinion, it is a good idea.
Give a reason for your opinion.
One advantage is that it saves time.
A disadvantage is the high price.
Our class has a debate on Friday.

lesson.title: 4. Memberi alasan dan contoh
table: [[I like it because it is cheap.]]
[[It is cheap, so many people buy it.]]
[[Some apps, such as dictionaries, are useful.]]

lesson.title: 5. Menyatakan kontras
table: [[It is useful, but it is expensive.]]
[[It is useful. However, it is expensive.]]
[[Although it is expensive, I like it.]]
[[On the other hand, it saves time.]]

lesson.title: Although dan but tidak dipakai bersamaan
lesson.text: Dalam bahasa Indonesia kita bisa berkata *meskipun ..., tetapi ...*. Dalam bahasa Inggris pakai **salah satu**: [[Although it is expensive, I like it.]] atau [[It is expensive, but I like it.]]

lines.en: What do you think about school uniforms, Tom?
lines.id: Menurutmu bagaimana tentang seragam sekolah, Tom?

lines.en: In my opinion, they are important because they make all students equal.
lines.id: Menurutku seragam penting karena membuat semua siswa setara.

lines.en: I see your point, but I don't think so. Students can still be equal without uniforms.
lines.id: Aku paham maksudmu, tapi kurasa tidak. Siswa tetap bisa setara tanpa seragam.

lines.en: That's true. However, uniforms are cheaper than many different clothes.
lines.id: Itu benar. Namun, seragam lebih murah daripada banyak pakaian berbeda.

lines.en: You have a point. Maybe we partly agree.
lines.id: Kamu benar juga. Mungkin kita setuju sebagian.

lines.en: Do you think students should bring phones to school?
lines.id: Apakah menurutmu siswa boleh membawa ponsel ke sekolah?

lines.en: I think so. Phones are useful for looking up information.
lines.id: Kurasa boleh. Ponsel berguna untuk mencari informasi.

lines.en: I'm afraid I disagree. Although phones are useful, many students play games in class.
lines.id: Sayangnya aku tidak setuju. Meskipun berguna, banyak siswa bermain game di kelas.

lines.en: Good point. Maybe students can use them only for study.
lines.id: Poin bagus. Mungkin siswa boleh memakainya hanya untuk belajar.

lesson.title: Rumus paragraf pendapat
lesson.text: **Opini** (I think ...) → **Alasan 1** (because ...) → **Contoh** (for example ...) → **Sisi lain** (however ...) → **Kesimpulan** (so, in my opinion ...). Lima kalimat sudah cukup untuk paragraf pendapat yang rapi.

Dika: Menurutku, belajar daring lebih fleksibel. Kita bisa belajar di mana saja, dan kita bisa menonton ulang pelajaran yang direkam.
Salma: Aku paham maksudmu, tetapi aku tidak sepenuhnya setuju. Tidak semua siswa punya koneksi internet yang stabil. Selain itu, lebih sulit tetap fokus di rumah. Di sisi lain, aku mengakui bahwa belajar daring menghemat waktu perjalanan.
Dika: Benar. Mungkin gabungan keduanya adalah solusi terbaik. Salma: Aku sangat setuju.

qs.q: What is Dika's opinion about online learning?

qs.exp: Salma: "Not every student has a stable internet connection."
options: Not every student has stable internet.
Lessons are too short for online learning.
Teachers are not kind to online students.
It costs too much for most families.

qs.q: What advantage of online learning does Salma admit?

qs.exp: Dika: "a mix of both"; Salma: "I couldn't agree more."
options: A mix of both is best.
qs.q: What do they finally agree on?

read.text:
Dika: In my opinion, online learning is more flexible. We can study anywhere, and we can watch the recorded lessons again.
Salma: I see your point, but I don't entirely agree. Not every student has a stable internet connection. Besides, it is harder to stay focused at home. On the other hand, I admit that online learning saves travel time.
Dika: That's true. Maybe a mix of both is the best solution. Salma: I couldn't agree more.
read.title: Online Learning: A Discussion

Beberapa siswa mengeluh bahwa seragam sekolah membatasi kebebasan berekspresi. Mereka berpendapat bahwa pakaian menunjukkan kepribadian. Namun, ada alasan kuat untuk mempertahankan seragam.
Pertama, seragam mengurangi kesenjangan sosial, sehingga tak seorang pun merasa rendah diri karena pakaian mahal. Kedua, orang tua mengeluarkan lebih sedikit uang untuk pakaian sehari-hari. Oleh karena itu, menurut saya seragam sebaiknya dipertahankan di sekolah.

qs.q: What do some students complain about?

options: They are comfortable, so students like them.
They are fashionable, so students feel proud.
They are free, so parents do not pay.
qs.q: What is the first reason to keep uniforms?

read.text:
Some students complain that school uniforms limit their freedom of expression. They argue that clothes show personality. However, there are strong reasons to keep uniforms.
First, uniforms reduce social differences, so no one feels inferior because of expensive clothes. Second, parents spend less money on daily outfits. Therefore, in my view, uniforms should be maintained in schools.
read.title: School Uniforms

read.focus: Menyatakan pendapat: present simple dan modal
read.id:
Menurut pandangan saya, media sosial berguna bagi remaja karena membantu mereka tetap terhubung dengan teman. Misalnya, siswa dapat berbagi ide PR secara daring. Namun, media sosial juga bisa berbahaya jika orang terlalu lama memakainya.
Beberapa ahli mengatakan remaja sebaiknya memakai media sosial tidak lebih dari dua jam sehari. Saya sangat setuju dengan mereka. Jika remaja tidur larut karena ponselnya, mereka akan sulit berkonsentrasi di sekolah. Karena itu, orang tua harus membuat aturan yang jelas.

qs.exp: Teks: "helps them stay connected with friends".
options: It helps teens stay connected with friends.
It makes teens sleep early and wake up fresh.
It replaces school so teens study at home.
It is free of problems and safe for everyone.
qs.q: What is one advantage of social media?

qs.exp: Teks: "no more than two hours a day".
options: No more than two hours a day
Four hours a day, mostly in the evening
No phones at all, even for homework

qs.q: If teens sleep late, they ___ (find) it difficult to concentrate.
Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Orang tua harus membuat aturan yang jelas."

read.text:
In my view, social media is useful for teenagers because it helps them stay connected with friends. For example, students can share homework ideas online. Nevertheless, it can also be harmful when people spend too much time on it.
Some experts say teenagers should use social media for no more than two hours a day. I strongly agree with them. If teenagers sleep late because of their phones, they will find it difficult to concentrate at school. Therefore, parents must set clear rules.
read.title: Is Social Media Good for Teens?
